About GymButler

Your all-in-one gym companion — rebuilt for the modern web

Weight Percentages

Calculate training percentages from your working weight with customizable ranges. Set your min, max, and step values to match your program.

Weight Converter

Convert between kilograms and pounds instantly. Includes the handy "divide by 2, subtract 10%" mental math trick for quick estimates.

Timer

Countdown timer with round tracking for interval training. View your best, worst, and average round times at a glance.

Stopwatch

Track rest times with lap functionality. Detailed statistics help you optimize your training and minimize downtime.
